# Hyperlite Provider

Manages a Hyperlite server or cluster through its API v1.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hyperlite = {
      source = "hyperlite-hv/hyperlite"
    }
  }
}

# The address and the token can also come from HYPERLITE_SERVER and HYPERLITE_TOKEN.
provider "hyperlite" {
  server    = "https://hyperlite.example.internal:8000"
  api_token = var.hyperlite_token
  # The certificate's SHA-256, when the system does not trust it (shown by `hyperlite login`).
  # fingerprint = "AB12..."
}

variable "hyperlite_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_unverified_ssl` (Boolean) Accept any certificate. Only for a lab: pin the certificate with `fingerprint` instead.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) A personal API token (hlt_...), created in Account security. Defaults to the HYPERLITE_TOKEN environment variable.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's certificate, when the system does not trust it (a self-signed or internal certificate), as `hyperlite login` pins it. Defaults to the HYPERLITE_FINGERPRINT environment variable.
- `server` (String) Address of a Hyperlite node, e.g. https://hyperlite.example.internal:8000. Defaults to the HYPERLITE_SERVER environment variable.
